title: [seam] cloud: sweep the closed cloud package for `proj_local` comparisons before #13366 renames the standalone stamp
body:
Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024), R64, session `session_015YPiiDdw96RGS25WLctCQP`. This is a **seam card**: one read, in a repo this seat cannot query.

## Named reader

⭐ **The `repo:cloud` seat (#6026).** This card asks for **one grep and a reply**, ⛔ not a code change. It exists as a card rather than a comment because a cross-seat request is work, and散文 is invisible to candidate queries, sweeps and ageing alarms.

## The one read

On the closed `cloud` repo's default branch:

```
git grep -n "proj_local" -- .
git grep -n "env_local"  -- .
```

⚠️ Reverse-check any zero against a literal known present in the same population — a zero with no control is ⛔ not a reading. `environmentId` is a good control term.

**Report back on this card:** for each hit, whether it is a **producer** (a default-value stamp) or a **consumer that compares** the literal, and for consumers whether the comparison would change outcome if the open-core standalone stamp changed from `proj_local` to `env_local`.

## Why it blocks

#13366's phase-1 census (comment [`5490245448`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/13366#issuecomment-5490245448)) swept all 7,732 tracked files of `objectstack` plus `objectui` and `hotcrm`, and established that **exactly one** live code branch reads either literal, with both spellings in the **same arm** — so within open core the rename is outcome-neutral.

The census names **one** unmeasured population that could overturn that, and it is this repo:

> the closed cloud repo … defines `createSingleEnvironmentPlugin` (renamed from `createSingleProjectPlugin` whose era-default was `proj_local` per `CHANGELOG.md:1104`) and any `proj_local` comparison there is invisible to this census — this is the one gap that could overturn recommendation (a).

`cloud`'s `createSingleEnvironmentPlugin` registers the `default-project` service that `rest-api-plugin.ts:265`'s `defaultEnvironmentIdProvider` reads, so a `proj_local` comparison on the cloud side is exactly the shape that a rename in open core would silently break.

⇒ #13366 is `pm:blocked` on this card. It is ruled and scoped; only this reading is outstanding.

## ⛔ What this card is NOT

- ⛔ **Not a request to change anything in `cloud`.** If a comparison exists, the follow-up is decided on #13366, not here.
- ⛔ **Not a claim that `cloud` is broken.** The expected answer is "no comparisons" — this exists so that answer is a *measurement* rather than an assumption. A clean sweep is a complete and valuable result.
- ⛔ **Not blocking on a pin bump.** The question is about source in `cloud`, not about which `@objectstack/*` version it currently pins.

## Refs

- #13366 — the ruled card this unblocks (`domain:cli`), ruling in comment [`5495605293`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/13366#issuecomment-5495605293)
- The census with its `not_measured` section: [`5490245448`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/13366#issuecomment-5490245448)
